name: Eternal Flower
desc: A pendant with a flower ornament said to have the power to heal the wearer. Many people use it as a protective amulet, and it's a custom to pass it down from generation to generation.

eff.name: Eternal Wreath
eff.desc1: Continuously restores HP by [Lv. x 1]% at a set interval. Restores HP by [Lv. x 2]% when recovering from a status effect.

eff.name: Blossoming Garden
eff.desc1: Extends the duration of positive effects by [Lv. x 1] second(s) and reduces the duration of negative effects by [Lv. x 1] second(s).
